Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game. England have sealed their place in the semi final. West Indies are out of the race for the semi final spot. It will be double header on Monday, 2nd March as well. First Sri Lanka take on Bangladesh first. That match will begin at 1100 local (0000 GMT). Join us for that one. Till then, cheers!

England skipper, Heather Knight says that they spoke about running really well and did that as the pitch was on the slower side. Tells they needed to be clever with both the bat and ball. On the batting changes, she says they wanted to change somethings and credits Tammy to show. Says Mady is a great kid and she is happy for her performance. Tells they were getting nervous looking at Pakistan and just wanted to win.

West Indies vice-captain, Anisa Mohammed  says that they will need to go through the scans before making any comment on how serious Stafanie's injury is. Tells injury is something they can't control and they were unlucky tonight. Tells they were good on the field. Admits England got away in the death overs. Tells they need to work on their batting and they are disappointed not to qualify for the semi-final.

For her brilliant batting display, Natalie Sciver has been named the Player of the Match. Sciver says that it is coming off the bat nicely and it was a bit of a different innings today as the wicket was on the slower side. Says they knew if they batted well they could win this. Tells there was a game here before this and they knew they had to bat smart and well.

Earlier in the evening, after opting to bat. England put up a very good total of 143 on a slow wicket courtesy of 57 from Natalie Sciver along with starts from Danielle Wyatt and Heather Knight. Cameos from Amy Jones and Katherine Brunt also helped them go past 140. It was a decent bowling effort from West Indies as four bowlers picked up one wicket each.

A very professional performance with the ball from England. They bowled according to the plan and bowled on the surface which was a tricky one to bat. Sophie Ecclestone was the star with the ball as she ended up with 3-wickets. Mady Villiers and Anya Shrubsole had one wicket each. Overall it was a professional bowling display from them.

Chasing 144, West Indies' reply never got going. They kept lost Deandra Dottin and while Hayley Matthews was struggling at one end, Stafanie Taylor  was settling in. But the injury to skipper dented the confidence of the side and after her departure the Carribean side just threw in the towel. There was a late cameo from Lee-Ann Kirby but it was too little, too late.

A sorry performance with the bat from West Indies and their hopes of qualifying for the semi-finals also comes to an end. Supreme performance from England has sealed their spot in the final four stages of the tournament.

OUT! Bowled! That will be it as Stafanie Taylor won't be able to bat. Shorter and straighter on off, Anisa looks to cut but misses. The ball hits the off pole and that is the end of West Indies' innings. ENGLAND WIN BY 46 RUNS!
Short on off,  Mohammed pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Floated on off, Mohammed comes down the track and lofts it over extra covers for a boundary.
Shakera Selman walks out to bat now. She is essentially the last batter.

OUT! Run Out! Another suicidal run. No need for the third umpire this time as Alleyne is not even in the frame. Flighted on the pads, Alleyne sweeps it to square leg and goes for a quick single. Sarah Glenn gets t the ball and sends a very good throw at the bowler's end and Maddie does the rest.
Anisa Mohammed is the new batter.

OUT! Run Out! The end is very near for the West Indies now. Floated on off, Afy pushes it towards cover and goes for a quick single. The ball goes to Heather Knight quickly and she sends a good throw at the bowler's end. Fletcher is well short of her crease as Maddie whips the bails off. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays confirm that Fletcher is well short.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Fletcher looks to be short of her crease and it looks like an easy decision.
Flighted on off, Alleyne pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
FOUR! Alleyne will not go without a fight. Floated on middle, Aaliyah  lofts it over mid n and gets a boundary.
Wide! Darted down the leg side, Alleyne looks to flick but misses. Amy Jones misses it and they take two.
Short on off, Fletcher punches it to the off side.
Fuller on off, Afy pushes it towards cover.
The new batter is Afy Fletcher.

OUT! Stumped! Floated outside off, Cooper goes for a big drive with a lunge forward. She is too far out of her crease. Amy Jones shows quick reflexes and whips the bails off quickly. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and replays find Cooper well short. Amy Jones has had a good game so far. She was good with the bat tonight and now she is having a good day with the keeping gloves as well.
Stumping appeal taken upstairs.

Appeal for LBW turned down and then a missed direct hit. Darted on leg, Alleyne looks to defend but misses. The ball hits her pads and there is a stifled appeal from the bowler and the keeper. The batters go for a quick run and the fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end.
Floated on the stumps, Alleyne blocks it.
FOUR! Too straight down the leg side, Alleyne paddle sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
News - Confirmation that West Indies skipper, Stafanie Taylor will not come out to bat now.
Full on off, Alleyne pushes it towards cover and gets a single. 65 needed in 30 balls now.
Length ball on off, Cooper plays it to point and gets a single.
FOUR! Typical West Indian shot this from Cooper. Fuller on middle, Cooper whips it in calypso style over the vacant square leg fence for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Cooper punches it to the off side.
WIDE! Shrubsole has missed her line and sprayed it down the leg side.
FOUR! Smart batting, just using the pace of the ball. Good length ball on off, Coopr just opens the face of her bat and sends it to the third man fence for a boundary.
Aaliyah Alleyne is the new batter.

OUT! Kirby's luck and cameo comes to an end. After dropping Kirby earlier on, Sciver has redeemed herself. Full on off, Kirby has a whack at it but this time she cannot connect. The ball goes to the left of deep mid-wicket and Natalie Sciver this time makes no mistake and takes it with ease.
On off, Kirby swings at it and the ball goes towards mid-wicket for one and she keeps the strike.

DROPPED AND SIX! Katherine Brunt is the culprit now and Kirby is riding her luck here. Floated on middle, Kirby swings at it and it goes to the right of long on. Brun there gets both her hands to the ball but it pops out of her hand and goes over the ropes.
Another punch on the off side for one.
Short on off, Kirby punches it to the off side and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on middle, Cooper comes down the track and strokes it to long off for a run.
Floated on off, Cooper looks to defend but misses.
Floated on middle, Cooper lofts it wide of long on and gets a single.

IN THE AIR AND DROPPED! Natalie Sciver has put down an easy chance and that is the only thing that she has done wrong so far. Glenn smartly takes the pace off this one. Kirby looks to slog sweep it but mistimes it due to the lack of pace in it. The ball goes high in the air to the right of mid-wicket. Natalie Sciver gets under it but fails to take the dolly. The ball pops in and out of her hand.
SIX! Finally a release shot from West Indies. Flighted delivery on middle, Kirby smokes it over mid-wicket and gets the first maximum of the game.
Kirby cuts too but finds the fielder.
Flatter outside off, Cooper cuts it towards point and gets a single.
Floated on off, Cooper pushes it back to the bowler.
Short on off, Cooper punches it towards cover and gets a single.
Flatter on off, Cooper punches it but finds cover.
Shorter on off, Kirby punches it towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary. Full toss on off from Maddie. Kirby makes the most of it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Shorter on off, Kirby punches it to the off side.
Shorter on off, Cooper pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter on off, Kirby punches it to the off side.
Tossed up on off, Kirby swings the bat and gets a top edge. Luckily for her it falls in no man's land at backward point.
Flighted on off, Kirby defends it with a dead bat.
Flatter on off, Kirby keeps it out.
Floated on the pads, Kirby flicks it to the leg side.
Lee-Ann Kirby walks out to bat now.

OUT! Caught behind! Excellent review from England and they are all over West Indies at the moment. They have put brakes on the scoring and that pressure has been converted into wickets. Flatter and quicker outside off, Nation looks to run it down to third man but misses. Amy Jones collects the ball and straightaway goes up in appeal. The umpire does not feel they have got their target. Heather Knight has a word with Sarah Glenn and Amy Jones and signals the 'T'. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows a spike as the ball goes past the glove. The original decision is overturned and West Indies are in deep trouble.
Heather Knight has taken a review for caught behind. England feel they have their woman. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Flighted on off, Cooper pushes it to cover to get through the over.
Flighted around off, Cooper plays it to point.
The new batter is Britney Cooper.

OUT! Brilliant catch from Maddie and she opens her account in World Cups. Floated delivery on middle, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it uppishly to the right of the bowler. Maddie moves and stretches to her right and takes a stunning catch. West Indies are struggling to get runs and they are also losing wickets at the other end to add salt to the injury. 102 needed in 62 now.
Flighted on middle, Campbelle blocks it.
Flatter on off, Campebelle looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flighted on off, Campbelle blocks it.
Maddie Villiers is into the attack now.
Shorter on off, Nation punches it off the back foot.
Floated outside off, Nation looks to defend but misses.

NOT OUT! Excellent review from Chedean Nation. She survives and West Indies' hopes also lives with her. Slider on leg, Nation looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. The English players go up in appeal and the umpire raises her fingers. Chedean has a word with her partner and then signals the 'T'. Replay rolls in and Ultra Edge shows no involvement of bat.
Nation has been adjudged LBW. She has taken it upstairs after having a chat with her partner.
Floated on off, Nation blocks it.
Chedean Nation walks out to bat now.

OUT! Bowled! Hayley Matthews struggling innings comes to an end. Floated delivery on leg, Hayley who has struggled to get going, looks to drive this one. She misses and the ball hits the leg pole. Hayley walks back and things going from bad to worse for the West Indies. 102 needed in 70 balls now and with their skipper also out with an injury the task in hand has got even bigger.
Floated on off, Campbelle defends it with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.

Stafanie Taylor is in some discomfort and the physio is out now having a look. She is in a lot pain here and this is bad news for West Indies. The stretcher is out now and she is going off. The West Indian skipper is in tears as she is going off. Shemaine Campbelle  walks out to bat now.
Punched off the back foot by the batter. They run through for a single.

DROPPED! Tough chance but Schrubsole thinks she should have taken it. Good length on off, Taylor pulls it over mid-wicket. Schrubsole jumps and gets both his hands on it. She cannot bask it in and the ball goes behind. Two runs taken. Stafanie Taylor has hurt herself while taking the second run.
Length ball on off, Taylor punches it towards cover and gets a single.
On the pads, Taylor looks to flick but misses. The ball goes to the leg side off her pads and they take two leg byes.
Good length ball on off, Taylor plays it to point.
On the pads, Hayley flicks it to the leg side and gets a single.
Natalie Sciver is back on.
Flatter and around off, Matthews cuts it to point for a single.
FOUR! That is crunched! Glenn tosses one up and outside off, Matthews cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter and around off, Matthews pushes the ball to covers.
Flatter and on leg, Taylor misses her flick and gets it off the pads towards the leg side for a leg bye.
Flatter and outside off, Matthews punches the ball towards long off and takes a single.
Leg spinner outside off, Matthews plays it to point.
Sarah Glenn is on now.
FOUR! Good way to end the over. This time Brunt goes wide outside off, Brunt punches it right off the meat through cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! That is brute of a shot from Stafanie. length delivery on off and middle, Taylor goes aerial and heaves it over mid on for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Stafanie looks to defend but does so uppishly as the ball sticks on the surface and comes on her. Luckily it is wide of Katherine.

Not Out! Taylor is in! Brunt bowls one down the leg side, Taylor looks to flick but misses. Amy Jones, behind the stumps, takes it nicely and whips the bails off quickly. The square leg umpire goes upstairs and replays show Taylor is safe. Wided by the umpire as well.
Stumping check sent upstairs. Taylor is the one in question. Replays show that Taylor's foot went nowhere when Jones whipped the bails off.
On the pads, Taylor flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Length ball on off, Stafanie looks to dab it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle and leg, Stafanie looks to drive but gets an inside edge which goes to the on side. They take a brace.

Not Out! Matthews is in! On the pads, Stafanie looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes to the leg side. They take a leg bye. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end and scores a direct hit. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show even though Hayley was casual in her approach, she is in.
Run out check sent upstairs. Matthews is in question as she is a bit lazy in getting inside the safe zone. Lets see what the replays show.
This time Stafanie  manages to connect with the punch but finds the fielder.
Shorter outside off, Tayloe looks to cut but misses.
On the pads, Stafanie looks to flick but misses.

How has that miss the stumps? Superb delivery from Ecclestone. Floated on middle and leg, it spins in and misses the swing of Hayley's bat and also the stumps. Amy Jones fails to gather the ball and they steal a bye.
On the pads, Matthews looks to flick but the ball kisses the pads.
Short and on off, Taylor looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge on this one past the stumps and goes on the leg side.
Length ball on off, driven straight to mid off.
Short ball on middle, Matthews pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a single as the ball goes on the bounce to the fielder in the deep.
Full and on middle, Matthews drives it towards mid on now.
Full and on the pads, Matthews flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Punched towards covers.
Natalie Sciver is on now.
Stafanie Taylor is the new batter in.

OUT! Caught! England draw first blood. Ecclestone strike on the last ball of her first over. Floated on off, Dottin looks to sweep it but she ends up hitting it uppishly towards short mid-wicket. Dottin also loses her balance as she tries to play that shot. It goes to the right of Natalie Sciver. She can do no wrong today and she takes a fine catch. Early blow for West Indies.

Good fielding from Wyatt! Saves a boundary for her side. Short and spinning away, Matthews cuts it hard to the left of point. Wyatt there dives and saves runs for her side. She cannot gather it cleanly and that allows them to take a run.
Flighted on middle, Hayley pushes it to cover.
Quicker and slightly shorter on middle, Matthews looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Floated on off, Matthews defends it towards point.
WIDE! Ecclestone misses her line and darts one down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Ecclestone starts with a flighted deliver around the pads, Dottin flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Sophie Ecclestone is on now.
Full and on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on leg, Dottin plays it to the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! That is a sign of better things to come in the batting.It is short and wide outside off, Dottin plays it through covers for a single.
Length ball on leg, once again Dottin misses her flick as the ball rolls towards the leg side.
Full and on the pads, Dottin misses her flick and the ball fall to the side of the pitch.
Length ball on off, Dottin plays it to covers.
Length ball wide outside off, Matthews looks to cut but under edges it to short third man. Good start from England and Shrubsole. Just a run off her first.
Full on off, Dottin looks to drive but gets an inside edge which goes to the on side.

Direct hit and Mathews would have been gone for all money. Full on off, Matthews defends it towards cover and calls for a quick single. Tammy Beaumont gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the bowler's end. She misses and Hayley survives.
Full and straight on off, Hayley pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and angling in from around off, Matthews defends it with a straight bat.
BEATEN FIRST UP! Length ball outside off, Matthews is on the front foot to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge. Good start with the ball from Anya.

We are back for West Indies' reply. England players are ready with the ball on the field. Out come the two West Indies openers Hayley Matthews and Deandra Dottin come out to start their innings. Anya Shrubsole to start with the ball.
